(()=>{window.fenaSet=(id,v)=>{const e=document.querySelector('#anatomy-'+id);Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype,'value').set.call(e,v);e.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));};window.fenaUnit=(id,v)=>{const e=document.querySelector('#anatomy-'+id).closest('.input-wrap').querySelector('select');e.value=String(v);e.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));};if(document.querySelector('[data-anatomy-result]').textContent!=='—'||document.querySelector('.fena-svg').dataset.fenaValid!=='false')throw Error('Cleared form state');return 'Empty shared form hides result and geometry';})()

(()=>{const d=document.querySelector('.fena-svg').dataset;if(Math.abs(Number(d.fenaSodiumRatio)-1/7)>1e-10||Number(d.fenaCreatinineRatio)!==100||document.querySelector('.result-number').textContent!=='0,14')throw Error('Registry computation');window.fenaBase={...d};return 'True sodium and creatinine concentration ratios agree with main result';})()

(()=>{const s=document.querySelector('.fena-svg');if(JSON.stringify(s.dataset)===JSON.stringify(window.fenaBase)||document.querySelector('#field-sodium').value!=='280')throw Error('Parameter/shared sensitivity sodium');return 'sodium independently changes shared computation and sample geometry';})()

(()=>{const svg=document.querySelector('.fena-svg'),handle=svg.querySelector('.fena-handle rect');const send=(target,type,active)=>{const t=new Touch({identifier:7,target,clientX:10,clientY:10});const e=new TouchEvent(type,{bubbles:true,cancelable:true,touches:active?[t]:[],changedTouches:[t]});target.dispatchEvent(e);return e.defaultPrevented;};if(!send(handle,'touchstart',true)||!send(handle,'touchmove',true))throw Error('Handle must cancel native touch scrolling');send(handle,'touchcancel',false);if(send(svg,'touchstart',true)||send(svg,'touchmove',true))throw Error('Non-controls must preserve scrolling');send(svg,'touchend',false);if(send(svg,'touchmove',true))throw Error('Touch cancellation did not release');return 'Native cancelable touchstart/move preventDefault on handles; non-control touches and cancel/end release preserve page scrolling';})()

(()=>{const rs=[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-fena-target]')].map(e=>e.getBoundingClientRect());if(rs.some(r=>r.width<43.9||r.height<43.9))throw Error('Under 44px target');for(let i=0;i<rs.length;i++)for(let j=i+1;j<rs.length;j++){const a=rs[i],b=rs[j];if(a.left<b.right&&a.right>b.left&&a.top<b.bottom&&a.bottom>b.top)throw Error('Overlapping controls');}if(document.documentElement.scrollWidth>innerWidth)throw Error('Horizontal overflow');return 'Four separate 44px targets and no horizontal overflow';})()

(()=>{const d=document.querySelector('.fena-svg').dataset;if(Number(d.fenaHeightUrineSodium)!==0||document.querySelector('[data-fena-group=sample][data-fena-field=urineSodium]').innerHTML!==''||document.querySelector('.result-number').textContent!=='0,00')throw Error('Zero sodium');return 'Zero urinary sodium has no insert and a true zero result';})()

(()=>{const svg=document.querySelector('.fena-svg');if(svg.dataset.fenaResult!==undefined||[...svg.querySelectorAll('[data-fena-group=sample],[data-fena-group=cap]')].some(e=>e.style.display!=='none')||document.querySelector('.result-number').textContent!=='—')throw Error('Stale invalid state');return 'Invalid form immediately clears live datasets, inserts, caps and both results';})()
